purpose: Document first-party local registry context and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review for Sanya, China.
assessment: Sanya's official Natural Resources and Planning Bureau site identifies a municipal real-estate-registration center and dedicated cadastral-map information materials. An official notice says cadastral-map (宗地图) information may be queried with property-owner authorization. The public Sanya geospatial-platform link timed out in a bounded anonymous GET; no parcel feature API, safe native ID, schema, or CRS was verified.
